hero.headline: We break things to understand them.
hero.intro: Zerologon is a student group of hackers, defenders, and researchers. We run CTFs, workshops, and talks on campus.
hero.gridCaption: CVE-2020-1472, the bug we’re named after: about one login attempt in 256 succeeds using nothing but zeros.

paragraphs: Zerologon is the official cybersecurity cell of our college. We’re named after the Windows vulnerability CVE-2020-1472.
We run CTFs, workshops, and talks on campus, and our members work on everything from reverse engineering malware to web exploitation.
